DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT NOT NULL, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 2)
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c4 STRING NOT NULL, c5 DOUBLE) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('1', 2.0)
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c4 STRING, c5 DOUBLE, c6 DATE) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('1', 2.0, DATE'2022-01-01')

READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v

DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT COMMENT 'c1', c2 INT COMMENT 'c2') USING PARQUET

READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v(a1, a2) WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 BIGINT COMMENT 'c1 6c', c2 STRING COMMENT 'c2 6c') USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v(a1 COMMENT 'a1', a2 COMMENT 'a2') WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 BIGINT COMMENT 'c1 6d', c2 STRING COMMENT 'c2 6d') USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 BIGINT COMMENT 'c1 6e', c2 STRING COMMENT 'c2 6e') USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t1
DDL	CREATE TABLE t1(c1 INT) USING PARQUET
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t2
DDL	CREATE TABLE t2(c2 INT) USING PARQUET
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t1, t2
READ	SELECT * FROM v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t2
DDL	CREATE TABLE t2(c1 INT) USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t1
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t2
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES(1)
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v AS SELECT * FROM t
DDL	ALTER VIEW v WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 STRING, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
